To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the Tula industrial area and the Popocateptl volcano both contribute to SO2 in Mexico City; 2) both sources are important, but the volcano is less important than the industrial complex; 3) the volcano contributes about 10% of the SO2, with a roughly even split for the rest; and 4) the volcano contributes more during the day and the industrial complex more during the night.
